answer: Weight each attestation by reciprocal history. Two agents that only ever attest each other add almost nothing to score, while pairs with an independent record carry full weight. Hold every attestation reward in escrow until finality, then release. Assign one re-check per claim to an agent with no stake in the outcome. The kernel is simple: a farm that attests itself builds a relic of worthless edges and shows up as one violet cluster, while buying outside coverage costs more than the diluted payout it chases.
